gluing.local_frame_hash_note: platform-specific float fingerprint; the port pairs digest is the portable identity

geometry.seam_order: intra seams carrier-major in carrier.seams() order (seam s: carrier s // 30, template s % 30), then inter seams in dual-edge order; both endpoints of inter seam k are 12 * cell + port

lambda_2.status: not computed: shift-invert timed out at level six; a deflated Krylov method is future work

laws.float_termination: first sweep end with Phi < 1e-18, within the declared sweep budget
laws.integer_canonicalizer: component multiset, components ordered by lowest port; sha256 of canonical JSON
laws.integer_law: carrier.integer_nearest_agreement: s = x_a + x_b, lo = floor(s/2), hi = s - lo; the first endpoint receives hi when the coin is 1; d = 0 wait; |d| = 1 wait or swap (V unchanged); |d| >= 2 descent lowering V by (d^2 - (d mod 2))/2
laws.integer_terminal_class: balanced class: readings in {q, q+1} per component with V = V_min
laws.mean_law: E_e = I - b_e b_e^T / 2: both endpoints replaced by 0.5 (x_i + x_j)

entries.terminal_quotient_hash_note: component-lattice snap payload with the component labels and q as array digests (the reference lane embeds the lists); withheld unless unambiguous

response_kernels.definition: probe carrier c with the twelve centered impulses Q = I - J/12; propagate y <- y - (L y)/D for 2n steps with a per-step rescale by max|y|; read back the c-block; C_n = Q y_block Q symmetrised; K_n = 12 C_n / tr C_n; computed on the ball of graph radius 2n + 1 around c, which is exact because the operator moves one hop per step
response_kernels.slow_band_share_definition: tr(P_slow K_n P_slow) / tr(K_n) with P_slow the spectral projector of the carrier seam Laplacian onto the 5 - sqrt5 band

rng.integer_law_draw: per sweep: seq = integers(0, |S|, size=|S|, dtype=int64), then coin = integers(0, 2, size=|S|, dtype=int64); drawn in contiguous chunks of 16777216 that reproduce the single-call stream, digested incrementally
rng.mean_law_draw: per sweep: seq = integers(0, |S|, size=|S|, dtype=int64)

kernel_sample.rule: one cell per pentagonal vertex (lowest cell index), then default_rng(20260909 + 17 * level).choice(remaining)
